description: compose.dev.yaml with the dev difference (target, host user, mounted code) passes

tool_input.content:
name: dev-${APP_NAME:-shop}

services:
  nuxt:
    container_name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-nuxt
    build:
      target: dev
    user: "${UID:-1000}:${GID:-1000}"
    command: sh -c "npm install && npm run dev"
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    volumes:
      - ./:/app
  postgres:
    container_name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-postgres
    build:
      target: dev
    user: "${UID:-1000}:${GID:-1000}"
    volumes:
      - ./docker/postgres/data/dev:/var/lib/postgresql

description: compose.prod.yaml with the prod difference (registry image, target, .env.prod) passes

tool_input.content:
name: ${APP_NAME:-shop}

services:
  nuxt:
    container_name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-nuxt
    image: ${REGISTRY:-registry.example.com/shop}/${APP_NAME:-shop}-nuxt:${IMAGE_TAG:-latest}
    build:
      target: prod
    env_file:
      - path: .env.prod
        required: false
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT:-80}:3000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    container_name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-postgres
    build:
      target: prod
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:?set DB_PASSWORD in .env.prod}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR:-./docker/postgres/data/prod}:/var/lib/postgresql
